channel.title: HormuzTracker.tech — Strait of Hormuz Crisis Monitor
channel.description: Real-time Strait of Hormuz monitoring. Track shipping disruptions, oil prices, vessel seizures, insurance status, and global trade impact.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis — Day 87: Restricted Passage Continues
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains restricted to commercial shipping. Brent crude holds above $116 as the crisis enters its 87th day. 9/9 major carriers suspended, P&I clubs withdrawn.

item.title: Beijing Summit: China Proposes Multi-Party Security Framework
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister presents comprehensive security framework involving Gulf states and Iran for safe passage through the Strait.

item.title: Oil Prices Surge: Brent Crude Holds Above $116
item.description: Brent crude remains elevated at $116.73, up 56% from pre-crisis levels of $74.50. WTI, TTF, and gasoline prices all significantly higher.

item.title: All Major Shipping Carriers Suspend Hormuz Transit
item.description: 9 out of 9 major container shipping lines have suspended transits through the Strait of Hormuz. Emergency surcharges of $1,500-$4,000 per TEU in effect.

item.title: P&I Insurance Withdrawn: All Major Clubs Cancel Coverage
item.description: All six major Protection and Indemnity clubs have cancelled Hormuz transit coverage. War risk premiums have increased from 0.125% to over 1.2%.

item.title: Consumer Impact: How Much More Are You Paying?
item.description: US gasoline prices up 38.7% from pre-crisis levels. Use our Consumer Impact Calculator to see how the Hormuz crisis affects your wallet.

item.title: Historical Comparison: How Does This Crisis Stack Up?
item.description: From the 1973 OPEC embargo to the 2024 Red Sea disruption, we compare the current Hormuz crisis to major historical oil supply disruptions.
